rounds.title: Picture baseline
rounds.note: The SDK picture (et-picture), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design, framed as its story does (max 520px, surface fill, 14px text). A figure with a picture (sources + img) and an optional figcaption; the component paints nothing itself: no colour, edge, radius, focus ring or interactive state exists in the lib. The caption inherits the surface text; placeholder and error slots are overlaid on the reserved box and bring their own look (story: a rect skeleton, a 12px muted line). Images are local SVG assets with preserveAspectRatio none so they stretch like a raster would. States: default (art direction: the tall 3:4 source wins at 480px and is stretched into the 16:9 box, as the lib does without fit), ratio-4-3, no-ratio (natural size), width-height (800x450 attributes, no reserved ratio), no-caption, long-caption (wraps), fit (contain, cover, fill, none, scale-down in a 180x120 box; dashed outline is the frame, not the lib), loading (placeholder skeleton, no URL yet), error-slot, error-bare (browser broken icon with alt text). Numbers (light / dark) against the page: caption 17.93 / 17.18, error-slot text (muted) 7.81 / 6.94, both above 4.5. Q98, numbers only: the story's skeleton placeholder fill vs page 1.16 / 1.22; the picture itself has no fill or edge. No decided rule arises: Q88 (no focus ring), Q99 (no accent mark; mint appears only inside the sample image), Q101 (no button), so no Q102 and no c. Variant a only.

a.note: Today, and the only variant: no decided rule applies to a component that paints nothing. Caption 17.93 / 17.18, muted error text 7.81 / 6.94, skeleton placeholder vs page 1.16 / 1.22 (light / dark). Art-directed sources in a fixed ratio stretch without fit.
